question: A and B start a business with investments of Rs. 18,000 and Rs. 24,000, respectively. If the profit-sharing ratio is 3 : 4, determine the ratio of the time periods for which A and B invested.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Investment Ratio of A and B = 18,000 : 24,000 = 3 : 4

Given Profit Ratio of A and B = 3 : 4

Since Profit = Investment × Time ⇒ Time = Profit ÷ Investment

Ratio of Time Periods = (3 ÷ 3) : (4 ÷ 4) = 1 : 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1 : 1.**
